items.prompt: Pens cost Rp3.500 each. Hadi buys 4 pens and pays with Rp20.000. How many rupiah change does he get?
A notebook costs Rp7.500 and a ruler costs Rp2.250. Joko buys 3 notebooks and 2 rulers and pays with Rp30.000. How many rupiah change does he get?
hints: Find the cost of the notebooks and the rulers separately.
Add them, then take the total from 30.000.

items.prompt: A pack of 6 stickers costs Rp9.000. One sticker on its own costs Rp1.700. How many rupiah more does it cost to buy 6 single stickers than one pack?
hints: Find the cost of 6 single stickers.

items.prompt: At a school warung, notebooks cost Rp6.500 each and pens cost Rp2.500 each. Sinta buys 3 notebooks and 5 pens. She pays with a Rp50.000 note.
hints: Multiply the price by the number bought.
